decisions.adaptation: Use a small, coherent elevation scale to separate canvas, record cards and reader. No tilted surfaces, parallax, translucent reading backgrounds or library adoption.

Use near-white canvas, navy text, slate metadata and white cards; retain existing Material-blue action emphasis. Use a subtle warm paper reader to balance cool chrome. Do not adopt gold accent or the returned dark financial palette.
Adopt its single-family, readable interface principle with locally available sans fallbacks. No external font download; do not claim Plus Jakarta Sans renders unless installed.
Wrap control groups before shrinking labels, provide true button/tab semantics and visible focus, and preserve visible research-question labeling.
